name: The Aletheia Institute — Livery
description: The named tinctures of the Institute. Canonical source of truth; css/main.css is held to these values by the test suite.

aletheia-midnight.$description: The brand field — the seal's azure. Heraldic azure: truth, loyalty, perseverance. On the site it appears as LIGHT (ambient glows behind interactive elements), never as ground.

midnight-ink.$description: The ground. Desaturated blue-black — the jeweler's velvet under the gold. Editorial, institutional; never lifts into cobalt.

veritas-gold.$description: The metal. Heraldic or: wisdom, elevation of the mind. Always foil, never flat athletic yellow. Coverage law: ≤ 15% of any composition.

gold-high.$description: Champagne highlight — the foil's hotspot. The brightest thing on any page; pure white is never used.

ledger-bronze.$description: The metal's shadow. Anchors every foil ramp; supplies the warm-dark register. Never a text color.

institute-ivory.$description: The text tincture — a tint of the gold hue (H45, L*94). 15.04:1 on midnight (AAA).

verity-teal.$description: Signal only: live states, citations, evidence markers. Luminance sits below the gold so the metal always wins. Never decoration. ≤ 2% of any viewport.

navy-elevated.$description: Raised surface — desaturated slate, not cobalt.

card.$description: Card fill — off-black slate. Elevation carried by fine gold hairline borders, not fill alone.

contrast.$description: Computed WCAG 2.1 ratios the suite re-verifies. Text tokens must clear 7:1 (AAA) on both grounds.
